LESSON: JESUS

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Early life
Topic 3.2: Jesus

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Jesus. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Example 1: Talk about Jesus using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS
